title.en: Common interpretation of a finite basis

claim.zh: 有限列表覆盖全部根基指标时，完整闭包逐命题存在可接纳解释，等价于一个可接纳解释满足整个闭包。
claim.en: When a finite list covers all basis indices, pointwise admissible interpretation of the full derived closure is equivalent to one admissible interpretation satisfying the entire closure.

hypotheses.zh: 既有 Derives、有限覆盖列表与显式 admissible；逐命题覆盖包括全部可导公式。
hypotheses.en: Existing Derives, a finite covering list and explicit admissible; pointwise coverage includes every derivable formula.

correspondence.zh: 没有定义 admissible 为根基成立；此归约不提供实际接纳或根基真。
correspondence.en: Admissible is not defined as basis truth; the reduction supplies neither actual admission nor root truth.

detail.zh: 反向从共同根基到共同闭包使用健全性；局部前提仍保留。
detail.en: The common-basis-to-common-closure direction uses soundness; local premises remain explicit.

detail.zh: 只让每一根基行分别有解释仍可能没有共同解释。
detail.en: Separate interpretations for individual basis rows may have no common interpretation.

limitations.zh: 只让每一根基行分别有解释仍可能没有共同解释。
limitations.en: Separate interpretations for individual basis rows may have no common interpretation.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 复用共同解释归约，进一步研究实际接纳与共同规律的实质根据。
next_delta.en: Reuse the coherence reduction; investigate substantive warrant for actual admission and a common law.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有成果身份与范围；不新增定理，不移动原始资料。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.
